story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번엔 초록빛 바람이 부는 담양으로 향합니다. 대나무의 고장이지요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon-en cho-rok-bit ba-ram-i bu-neun dam-yang-eu-ro hyang-ham-ni-da. dae-na-mu-ui go-jang-i-ji-yo.
story.en: Passengers, this time we're heading to Damyang, where a green breeze blows. It's the land of bamboo.

story.text: 저 아래 곧게 뻗은 초록 나무들, '대나무'예요. 사계절 내내 푸르러서 예로부터 곧은 선비의 마음에 비유되었답니다.
story.reading: jeo a-rae got-ge ppeot-eun cho-rok na-mu-deul, dae-na-mu-ye-yo. sa-gye-jeol nae-nae pu-reo-reo-seo ye-ro-bu-teo got-eun seon-bi-ui ma-eum-e bi-yu-doe-eot-dam-ni-da.
story.en: Those straight green trees below are 'bamboo'. Since it stays green all year round, it has long been compared to the upright heart of a scholar.

story.text: 담양에는 '죽녹원'이라는 큰 대나무 정원이 있어요. 울창한 대숲 사이로 여덟 갈래의 산책길이 나 있지요.
story.reading: dam-yang-e-neun juk-nok-won-i-ra-neun keun dae-na-mu jeong-won-i it-seo-yo. ul-chang-han dae-sup sa-i-ro yeo-deol gal-lae-ui san-chaek-gil-i na it-ji-yo.
story.en: In Damyang, there's a large bamboo garden called 'Juknokwon'. Eight walking trails run through the dense bamboo forest.

story.text: '대나무숲' 속을 걸으면 바람에 댓잎이 사각사각 소리를 내요. 맑은 공기와 함께 마음까지 시원해진답니다.
story.reading: dae-na-mu-sup sog-eul geol-eu-myeon ba-ram-e daet-ip-i sa-gag-sa-gag so-ri-reul nae-yo. malg-eun gong-gi-wa ham-kke ma-eum-kka-ji si-won-hae-jin-dam-ni-da.
story.en: Walking through the 'bamboo forest', the leaves rustle softly in the wind. Along with clean air, your mind becomes refreshed too.

story.text: 담양은 대나무 공예로도 유명해요. 대나무를 가늘게 쪼개 엮은 '소쿠리'는 지금도 부엌에서 쓰인답니다.
story.reading: dam-yang-eun dae-na-mu gong-ye-ro-do yu-myeong-hae-yo. dae-na-mu-reul ga-neul-ge jjo-gae yeog-eun so-ku-ri-neun ji-geum-do bu-eok-e-seo sseu-i-ndam-ni-da.
story.en: Damyang is also famous for bamboo crafts. The 'sokuri' (bamboo basket), woven from thinly split bamboo, is still used in kitchens today.

story.text: 여름밤에는 '죽부인'을 안고 잤어요. 대나무로 엮은 길쭉한 통으로, 시원한 바람이 통하게 해 주는 지혜로운 물건이에요.
story.reading: yeo-reum-bam-e-neun juk-bu-in-eul an-go ja-sseo-yo. dae-na-mu-ro yeog-eun gil-jjuk-han tong-eu-ro, si-won-han ba-ram-i tong-ha-ge hae ju-neun ji-hye-ro-un mul-geon-i-e-yo.
story.en: On summer nights, people slept hugging a 'jukbuin' (bamboo body pillow). It's a wise woven bamboo cylinder that lets cool air flow through.

story.text: 자, 초록빛 다섯 단어를 마음에 담으셨나요? 이제 시원하게 문제를 풀어볼까요!
story.reading: ja, cho-rok-bit da-seot dan-eo-reul ma-eum-e dam-eu-syeot-na-yo? i-je si-won-ha-ge mun-je-reul pul-eo-bol-kka-yo!
story.en: Now, have you kept the five green words in your heart? Let's solve some questions and cool off!

words.example_en: Your mind refreshes when you walk through a bamboo forest.
On summer nights, people sleep hugging a jukbuin.
You put fruit in the bamboo basket.

sentences.en: Bamboo stays green all year round.
You breathe clean air in the bamboo forest.
The bamboo body pillow is woven from bamboo.
A bamboo basket holds things like a basket.
